required_fixes: Provide OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable for real gpt-4o-mini model calls with token counting (spec measurement_validity #4, #8)
Install openai SDK (pip install openai) and playwright SDK (pip install playwright && playwright install chromium)
Configure nginx 1.24.0 reverse proxy with proxy_cache for HIT/SWR/SIE/304 stages matching EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543 substrate (nginx.conf hash recorded)
Deploy Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 + SQLite testbed_server.py with perturbation endpoints (F-DOM: DOM attr/text, F-ENDPOINT: param/header, F-CACHE: Cache-Control/ETag)

Implement execute_delta_repair_real.py with real LLM calls (record model id gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0.0, max_tokens, provider, per-call token counts, 15-step budget), real Playwright execution (goto/click/fill/evaluate/fetch with trace logs), and real verify() on actual DOM/response state (selector existence via Playwright evaluate, status/header/body match) with independent oracle for false accepts

Execute 48 perturbation instances (3 families x2 variants x8 seeds) with N>=24 unrelated mechanisms, family-stratified TRAIN24/TEST24 split (TRAIN seeds 0-3, TEST seeds 4-7 per variant), registry clone isolation, cache purge per instance, perturbation manifest holdout (never in repair prompt), verification threshold fit on TRAIN only

Compute all metrics on TEST with trajectory-grouped uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI for rates, instance-block bootstrap 2000 resamples for cost ratios, block-permutation for verification/retrieval nulls, apply frozen decision rule C1-C8 exactly
